title: Icicle dtsi: MSS QSPI, reference clocks and the system-controller QSPI flash (U43)
ref: master, retrieved 2026-10-16 (files pinned by git blob sha1 below)
note: refclk 125 MHz: X2 through R136/R138 to MSS_REFCLK_IN_P/N (U1 L7/L8); refclk_ccc 50 MHz: X5 through R496 to W12. The MT25QL01GBBB8ESF on the system-controller SPI is disabled on ES silicon (comment in the source).
lines: * The flash *is* there, but Icicle kits that have engineering sample
* silicon (write?) access to this flash to non-functional. The system
* controller itself can actually access it, but the MSS cannot write
* an image there. Instantiating a coreQSPI in the fabric & connecting
* it to the flash instead should work though. Pre-production or later
* silicon does not have this issue.
